results.title: Enhanced Fine-Tuning Techniques for Domain-Specific AI ...
results.content: For instance, a language model initially trained on general text data might be fine-tuned with specialized domain data, such as medical journals, to enhance its performance in tasks like disease diagnosis or medical information retrieval. **Transfer Learning**: Leveraging general-purpose models as a starting point, then fine-tuning with domain-specific data, can yield high-performance results with less data. To apply transfer learning, start by loading a pre-trained model, freezing specific layers to retain learned features, and fine-tuning the remaining layers on domain-specific data. In this example, we load a pre-trained model (e.g., InceptionV3 for image classification), freeze initial layers, and fine-tune the remaining layers with domain-specific data. A structured approach to fine-tuning pre-trained models ensures optimized domain-specific performance, capturing nuances unique to fields like healthcare, finance, or legal analysis.”. This approach is particularly useful in transfer learning and fine-tuning scenarios, as it allows a model to retain general knowledge from its pre-trained state while learning new, domain-specific information in the unfrozen layers.

results.content: ## Machine Learning with Applications. Volume 6, 15 December 2021, 100134. # Deep learning in computer vision: A critical review of emerging techniques and application scenarios. Author links open overlay panel, , ,. Deep learning has been overwhelmingly successful in computer vision (CV), natural language processing, and video/speech recognition. In this paper, our focus is on CV. We provide a critical review of recent achievements in terms of techniques and applications. We identify eight emerging techniques, investigate their origins and updates, and finally emphasize their applications in four key scenarios, including recognition, visual tracking, semantic segmentation, and image restoration. We recognize three development stages in the past decade and emphasize research trends for future works.
